6. HOW A CHANGE REACHES YOU
Changes are commits in this folder's own git history. Nothing leaves your machine unless you

7. HOW MUCH I DO ALONE: L3
The level (how much I may do before I ask you, from L1 to L6) is L3. I run a whole task and stop

Publishing anywhere, merging a task into main, raising the level, deleting files outside this
